title: Dates and strings
label: Dates and strings
checked: Date parsing, date parts, date rounding, periods, and time zones; string patterns, padding, truncation, and case. mutate() on all five backends.
description: tests/r/lubridate_stringr.R evaluates each case with lubridate and stringr and writes the results. The PHP tests evaluate the same expressions in each backend. Fixtures regenerated with the listed R versions on 2026-11-01; output byte-identical to the committed files.

inputs.name: date and string cases
inputs.detail: 5 rows of dates, datetimes, and text with NA; per-case vectors

comparison.applies_to: Column values; dates as YYYY-MM-DD, datetimes as YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS +hhmm in their time zone, numbers rounded to 9 decimal places, NA in identical positions
Polars column values; as above, with no fallback to a DataFrame except str_to_title(), which requires ICU word breaks

known_differences: SQL databases: functions without a faithful SQL translation run in memory after the query. These cases are compared identically.
reproduce: PHIBBLE_TEST_PGSQL="pgsql:host=127.0.0.1;port=5432;dbname=postgres" PHIBBLE_TEST_PGSQL_USER=postgres PHIBBLE_TEST_MYSQL="mysql:host=127.0.0.1;port=3306" PHIBBLE_TEST_MYSQL_USER=root php vendor/bin/pest tests/LubridateStringrTest.php tests/SqlTest.php
